description: First, who are we? We're AquaAirX Autonomous Systems - a Bengaluru-based deep-tech First, who are we? We're AquaAirX Autonomous Systems - a Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup building autonomous underwater and amphibious robots. Think inspection-class hovering AUVs that map dams and offshore assets (NEXOR), amphibious platforms that transition between air and water (AVATAAR), and an AI native ocean data platform (DeepNimbus). “Oh, and we're funded by Rainmatter (Zerodha) — so yes, the people who backed us know a thing or two about building for the long haul.” We work with defence, energy, and maritime customers on problems that genuinely matter: underwater infrastructure that nobody can see, but everybody depends on.
